en.html:
Kageaki"...You returned to avenge your father?"
Kanae"...Well. If I said I had no such wish, that would be a lie."
Kanae"Revenge on Shishiku alone? For that, I would not have come all the way back to this country."
Kageaki"..."
Kanae"There are two reasons why I returned to Yamato."
Kanae"One... To discharge my duty as one of exalted blood. The people were feeding us; protection was what we owed them in return."
Kanae"With Yamato facing danger such as it has never known, what business have I sitting comfortably in some distant country? Whatever needs doing to save the people of the land, that much is my obligation."
Sayo"Precisely. Precisely."

I too nodded without speaking.

Yes. That was the arrangement. Nobility, properly understood, was supposed to mean precisely that. Since its birth in ancient times, however, the duties had gradually been forgotten. The rights, meanwhile, had managed to grow only stronger.

Perhaps the Ootori had lasted so long partly because, generation after generation, its members had taken care not to forget the duty of their birth, as this lady Kanae had...

en.html:
Kanae"Though that child, strictly speaking, is more of an afterthought. On her account, I am not losing much peace."
Kageaki"What?"
Sayo"Quite so. By the time my lady left to study abroad, even the sisters' fighting record was coming close to fifty-fifty, if memory serves."
Kanae"I would win the wrestling, yes. Then I would be the one in the pitfall. Winning was not being allowed to settle anything..."
Sayo"Such accomplishments in foul scheming. One could only fear what this princess would grow into."
Kanae"Exactly. Not a bit like me."
Sayo"With my lady's accomplishments in foul violence, there was no shortage of family resemblance. Our master so gentle, our mistress so gentle—and the result, these two sisters from hell. What curse was supervising the result?"
Sayo"Unless, of course, you were actually picked up from under a bridge?"
Kanae"Nanny. One doubt I have had for some time. In your understanding, what is this thing called a master-and-servant relationship?"
Kageaki"..."

Sayo"In short, accepting the puppet's position for now is one thing. Accepting it forever is quite another. Lady Hanae is not a person from whom one should expect that much accommodation."
Kageaki"I see..."
Kanae"Give her a few more years only. She will remove Shishiku and become head in fact as well as name, without anyone's assistance. That is what I meant: for revenge alone, no need for me to return."
Kanae"Leave it to my sister, and she will settle things far more elegantly, with much less trouble to everyone around her. If I push myself in, I only spoil that arrangement. Knowing this, what am I to do?"
Sayo"For Shishiku too, that arrangement promises more suffering. Lady Hanae has the genuine article when it comes to cruelty. A quick killing would hardly be her choice; she would surely keep him alive, and keep the suffering going."
Kageaki"..."
Kanae"That is my sister for you. ...So the one I wanted to protect was not so much her as... the other one."
Kanae"Our cousin, Hanae's and mine. The rightful heir of the main Ootori house, whom Shishiku was searching for so desperately. ...It was him."
Kageaki"...? But—"

Sayo"Mr. Minato, political circumstances are not the whole of human relations. That much room we must leave for people."
Kageaki"...Yes."
Kanae"The complications were between the parents. The children had their own relations, you see. Hanae and I were both very fond of our cousin."
Kanae"Holding that little boy made me feel happy, somehow... Hanae felt the same, so there would be another fight over whose turn it was to hold him that day."
Kanae"Hanae claimed the right as his betrothed; I claimed it as his future elder sister-in-law. The right to have him in my arms was mine, each of us insisted. Neither would give way."
Kageaki"...I see."

Kageaki"Then, when you say you wanted to protect him—"
Kanae"He was living peacefully with a family distantly related to the Ootori. Knowing nothing. Make him head of the Ootori, and would he be happier? However I looked at it, leaving him as he was came out better."

en.html:
Her gaze pinned me down, feverish as though she were whispering of love.

My knees were trembling. I even felt the first warning of losing control of my bladder.

Such intent to kill.
Such malice.

This person meant to take revenge on me with all her life and soul.

No forgiveness was possible.
I would certainly be killed.

Now. This very moment, even.

I was afraid.

I had never before felt fear like this.

No—surely I had never known fear at all. This was fear.

I wanted to run away.
To scream.
Anything that could win a person's pity, I wanted desperately to do.

I wanted to cry and plead for forgiveness.

...Would she forgive me?

If I threw away shame and appearances, did anything at all, offered every explanation, apologized again and again, promised atonement... perhaps...

Even this woman... might forgive me...

Sayo"Naturally."
Kanae"Be easy. I am not saying this instant. Until the matter of Silver Star is settled, I shall wait. We shall cooperate as before."
Kanae"That is not a problem I can turn my eyes away from either. To resolve it, I need your strength."
Kanae"So... as soon as that is finished. Is that understood?"
Kageaki"............"
Kanae"Of course, I would not be so heartless as to tell you to die without resisting. Fight in that armor. Do not hold back. In fact, you have already seen it, but I too have an armor—"

香奈枝 「安心なさって。 　今すぐにとは申しません。銀星号の一件が 片付くまでは待って差し上げます。これまで 通り協力も致しましょう」
香奈枝 「あれはわたくしとしても知らぬふりのでき ない問題。 　解決するには景明さまのお力が要ります」
香奈枝 「ですから……それが済み次第・・・・・・・。 　よろしくって？」

en.html:
She said she would take revenge.
For Yuhi Nitta's cruel death, she would kill me.

She would never forgive Kageaki Minato.
She would kill me.

————Ah.

Perfect.

A perfect condemner.

A death meant for Kageaki Minato.

An execution befitting him.

This person would kill me.
—To avenge Yuhi Nitta's grief!!

The best, the highest ending I could possibly wish for.
Suddenly, it had come down from heaven.

Like a blessing.

There was justice in this world.
Judgment that would not forgive evil did exist.

Now, beyond this... I had nothing left to wish for.

ja.html:
復讐すると云う。
　新田雄飛の非業の死に懸けて、俺を殺すと云う。

　湊斗景明を決して許さず、
　殺してくれると云う。

　――――ああ。

　完璧だ。

　完璧なる断罪者だ。

　湊斗景明の為の死だ。

　相応しい処刑だ。

　この人が俺を殺してくれる。
　――新田雄飛の無念を晴らす為に!!

　望み得る限り、最高至上の結末。
　それは突然に天から降ってきた。

　恵みのように。

　この世に正義はあった。
　邪悪を許さぬ裁きは実在した。

　もう、これ以上……何も望むものはない。

I would discharge my duty. Defeat Silver Star.

And then, even if I, bound by Muramasa's curse, tried to kill one more person... it would be all right.

Before that, I would be killed.

—This beautiful woman would kill me.

en.html:
Kanae Ootori did not understand.

She had thought he might lose his senses and start screaming.
She had thought he might fly into a rage and attack.

She had thought he might cry and beg for his life.
She had thought he might steel himself, give up everything, and bow his head.

But this alone had never occurred to her.

————Gratitude.

She did not understand.

Kanae Ootori did not understand Kageaki Minato.
